def lines(chunks):
    """Yield decoded UTF-8 lines from an iterator of byte chunks.

    Chunk boundaries may split multibyte characters or CRLF line endings.
    ``\\r`` is stripped only when immediately followed by ``\\n``; a lone
    ``\\r`` is retained as part of the line. Empty lines are preserved, and a
    final unterminated line is emitted when nonempty. Invalid UTF-8 raises
    ``UnicodeDecodeError``.
    """
    pending = b""
    for chunk in chunks:
        pending += chunk
    try:
        text = pending.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise

    for index, char in enumerate(text):
        if char == "\n":
            line = text[:index]
            pending = text[index + 1:]
            yield line.rstrip("\r")
            continue
        line = text[:index + 1]
        pending = text[index + 1:]
        if index == len(text) - 1:
            if line:
                yield line.rstrip("\r")
            break
    if pending:
        yield pending.rstrip("\r")

def lines(chunks):
    """Yield decoded UTF-8 lines from an iterator of byte chunks.

    Chunk boundaries may split multibyte characters or CRLF line endings.
    ``\\r`` is stripped only when immediately followed by ``\\n``; a lone
    ``\\r`` is retained as part of the line. Empty lines are preserved, and a
    final unterminated line is emitted when nonempty. Invalid UTF-8 raises
    ``UnicodeDecodeError``.
    """
    pending = b""
    for chunk in chunks:
        pending += chunk
    try:
        text = pending.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise

    for index, char in enumerate(text):
        if char == "\n":
            line = text[:index]
            pending = text[index + 1:]
            yield line.rstrip("\r")
            continue
        line = text[:index + 1]
        pending = text[index + 1:]
        if index == len(text) - 1:
            if line:
                yield line.rstrip("\r")
            break
    if pending:
        yield pending.rstrip("\r")
